decision: The remaining web gap is a source-supply and bundle-quality problem. The current primary-web inventory collapses to two distinct roots, and the best unused cross-repo web candidate still needs evidence filtering before it can honestly enter the package.
next_best_step: Build a mixed-language web replenishment bundle compiler that filters venv/site-packages neighbors, materializes only maintainer-relevant web evidence, and routes the resulting bundle through rubric, anti-cheat, and gold adjudication before recompiling the standalone bounded package.
